text: Ivy (PM): quick questionWe keep getting feedback that the tiny 'performance' flame next to names isn't noticed. Should we move the badge into the metric column, add text, or enlarge it? Max (Design): i'd prefer moving it inline with the p99 metric so it's contextual. make it 16px and include a 1-word label 'fast' for screen readers. try two variants: icon+sr-only vs icon+visible microtext. Diego (Frontend): moving is fine. small perf hit if we render many icons but we can sprite it. also propose keyboard affordance: chevron + Enter expands metrics; badge should be reachable via tab and have role="button" if it shows extra info. Anya (A11y): please don't rely on color alone. if the badge conveys rank, add an accessible label and an additional text cue for low-vision users. ensure the badge has aria-pressed if toggle-like, or aria-hidden if purely decorative. Max (Design): good point. microcopy proposal: tooltip "Performance: fast" and visible tooltip text for touch? maybe use a small aria-visible token when space allows. Diego (Frontend): sample render plan: ```html fast ``` and for metrics expansion: set chevron button aria-expanded and move focus into the panel on open. Anya (A11y): ensure the expansion panel gets focusable controls and that opening announces "Metrics expanded for " via aria-live. Also test with NVDA/VoiceOver. Contrast of the microtext must be >=4.5. Ivy (PM): decision: Max to mock both placements (next to name vs next to p99) and include a visible microtext variant. Diego to prototype the aria patterns. Anya to run quick screen-reader smoke test. QA-bot will create a checklist. qa-bot: created checklist #778: include focus order, aria-labels, contrast checks, and mobile touch behavior. Max (Design): i'll upload mocks by EOD with token sizes and spacing notes. Using compact spacing for dense views and comfortable for expanded. Diego (Frontend): i'll land a small A/B in dev toggled behind feature flag so we can run quick usability before wide rollout. will ping when PR is up. Anya (A11y): will schedule a 30-min voiceover pass once the dev build exists. thanks! :white_check_mark:
